metrics.description: It measures whether every "fork in the road" (like an if statement) has been executed for both True and False results. It ensures that both the success and failure branches of a decision are validated.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Health Score = (Modules with MI >= 65 / Total Modules) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 80% of modules in green zone (MI >= 65)

metrics.description: Identifies exactly which lines of a function are covered by unit tests and which are ignored, helping developers write more focused tests by highlighting hidden blocks of code.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Granularity Score = (Functions with >= 1 dedicated unit test / Total Functions) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 90% of functions have at least one dedicated unit test

metrics.description: Identifies ghost code — lines that can never be executed regardless of input provided — measuring technical debt by finding unused functions or conditions that clutter the codebase.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Dead Code % = (Unexecuted Statements across all runs / Total Statements) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 2% dead code in production modules

metrics.description: Calculates the ratio of executed lines to total lines to show exactly where the holes are in your quality, measuring the thoroughness of the testing process.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Gap Score = (Uncovered Statement Blocks / Total Statement Blocks) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 20% uncovered statement blocks (80% coverage floor)

metrics.description: Verifies that the code can at least run from start to finish without crashing on a fundamental level, measuring the smoke test success of your logic to ensure the most basic paths are operational.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Smoke Pass Rate % = (Statements Executed without runtime error / Total Statements Executed) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of executed statements complete without runtime exception

metrics.description: % of executable source statements exercised by the test suite at least once
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Statement Coverage % = (Statements Executed / Total Statements) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 80% statement coverage

metrics.description: Evaluates the behavior of complex logical expressions to ensure they branch correctly under different data inputs, measuring the correctness of how your code handles logical operators.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Boolean Coverage % = (Logical Sub-expressions evaluated True AND False / Total Sub-expressions × 2) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 70% of boolean sub-expressions fully evaluated

metrics.description: Verifies the physical transitions between different blocks of code to ensure execution order matches the intended design, measuring the reliability of jumps and calls within your function.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Sequence Pass Rate % = (Valid Execution Transitions / Total Expected Transitions) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of expected code transitions execute in correct sequence

metrics.description: Measures whether loops correctly handle the decision to start, continue, and terminate, specifically testing the zero-trip, one-trip, and n-trip paths.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Loop Boundary Coverage % = (Loop Paths Tested: zero-trip + one-trip + n-trip / Total Loop Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of loops tested for zero-trip, one-trip, and n-trip paths

metrics.description: Identifies logical failures at the extreme limits of input values such as empty lists or None types, measuring the robustness of your branches when they encounter unexpected data.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Edge Failure Rate % = (Branch failures at boundary inputs / Total Boundary Input Tests) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 1% edge case branch failures

metrics.description: Uncovers flaws where the code takes the wrong turn due to a mistake in the conditional expression, acting as a diagnostic tool for semantic bugs that produce the wrong result without crashing.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Misdirection Count = Count(Branches producing incorrect output despite execution)
metrics.expected_threshold: 0 branches producing semantically incorrect results

metrics.description: Calculates the percentage of successfully executed branches versus total available decision points, showing exactly which else or elif blocks have never been visited by your tests.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Decision Gap % = (Untested Decision Branches / Total Decision Branches) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 30% decision branches untested (70% branch coverage floor)

metrics.description: % of true/false branches of every decision point executed by tests
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Branch Coverage % = (Branches Hit / Total Branches) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 70% branch coverage

metrics.description: Records exactly which sequences of statements and branches are hit during active testing, providing physical proof of which routes in the code were traveled by a specific test case.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Execution Trace Coverage % = (Recorded Execution Paths / Total Feasible Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 60% of feasible paths traced during test runs

metrics.description: Confirms that every unique path identified by the complexity metric has been successfully traveled, measuring completeness of the test suite against the theoretical maximum of the code logic.

metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Full Path Validation % = (Paths fully traversed start-to-end / Total CC-derived Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of CC-derived paths traversed at least once

metrics.description: Highlights logical routes that have only been partially tested or completely ignored, acting as a diagnostic tool to find blind spots where complex logic remains unverified.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Path Gap % = (Partially or untested paths / Total Feasible Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 40% of paths untested (60% floor)

metrics.description: Measures system stability when multiple decision points are stacked within one another, ensuring the deepest levels of code hierarchy are reachable and functional.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Nesting Depth Coverage % = (Paths through nesting depth > 3 tested / Total Deep Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 60% of deeply nested paths (depth > 3) exercised

metrics.description: Specifically focuses on paths that enter, repeat, or skip loops entirely, measuring how the code handles different iteration counts including the zero-trip path where the loop never executes.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Loop Path Coverage % = (Zero-trip + One-trip + N-trip paths tested / Total Loop Path variants) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of loop variants (zero, one, n-trip) tested per loop

metrics.description: Identifies logical routes that can never be executed due to contradictory conditions or dead code, reducing technical debt by pointing out logic that clutters the system without providing value.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Ghost Path % = (Logically unreachable paths detected / Total Declared Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 2% of declared paths are unreachable (ghost code)

metrics.description: Measures the code ability to gracefully handle and recover from unexpected errors or try-except blocks, ensuring the system does not crash when forced into a failure state.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Exception Path Coverage % = (Exception / Error paths exercised / Total Exception Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 80% of exception paths exercised in test suite

metrics.description: Tracks how logic flows across multiple functions or modules to complete a single task, measuring integration quality between different parts of the application.
metrics.derivation:
Cross Function Coverage =
sum(covered_lines across functions)
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Integration Path Coverage % = (Cross-function paths tested / Total Cross-function paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 60% of cross-component paths verified

python.derivation:
Cross Function Coverage =
sum(covered_lines across functions)

metrics.description: Embeds path verification into the automated pipeline to prevent untested logic from reaching production, measuring compliance with quality standards in real-time.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Pipeline Path Gate % = (Builds passing path coverage gate / Total Builds) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of builds pass minimum 60% path coverage gate

metrics.description: % of all distinct execution paths through a function that are exercised by the test suite
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Path Coverage % = (Paths Exercised / Total Feasible Paths) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 60% path coverage (complex functions)

metrics.description: Change in test coverage percentage between current build and previous baseline — monitors coverage trends
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Coverage Delta = Coverage_Current% – Coverage_Previous%
metrics.expected_threshold: Delta >= 0% (no coverage regression); flag if delta < -2%

metrics.description: Evaluates how many unique logical journeys through the code are validated by current test cases, measuring the ratio of executed paths to total possible paths.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Discovery Power % = (New Code Lines Covered by Tests / Total New Code Lines Added) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 80% of new code lines covered by test suite

metrics.description: Acts as an automated threshold that prevents code from being merged if the coverage delta is negative, ensuring that only logically verified code moves toward production.
metrics.derivation:
Quality Gate =
IF current.percent_covered >= threshold
AND current.percent_branches_covered >= threshold
THEN PASS ELSE FAIL
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Gate Compliance % = (Builds with Coverage Delta >= 0 / Total Builds) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of builds show non-negative coverage delta

metrics.description: Identifies which specific logical paths are altered by a code change and which downstream paths might be affected, measuring the logical surface area of a modification to predict unintended side effects.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Ripple Coverage % = (Downstream Modules re-tested after coverage delta trigger / Total Affected Modules) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of affected downstream modules re-verified

metrics.description: Specifically measures whether newly added lines or paths have corresponding test cases, ensuring that the MVP growth is supported by an equal growth in testing depth.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Fresh Coverage % = (New/Modified Functions with test coverage / Total New/Modified Functions) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of new or modified functions have test coverage

metrics.description: Provides a quantitative score of how much simpler or safer the code becomes after refactoring, measuring the successful reduction of complex untestable paths into cleaner sequences.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Health Benchmark Score = AVG(Coverage Delta) over rolling 5-sprint window
metrics.expected_threshold: AVG rolling delta >= +1% (continuous improvement trend)
